label: Cost per die at probe
subgoals: Add the scan pattern time to the fixed overhead per touchdown
Multiply the touchdown time by the tester cost rate
Divide the cost by the number of sites per touchdown

label: Final test throughput
subgoals: Multiply the sites by the multi-site efficiency
Add the test time and the handler index time
Divide 3600 times the effective sites by the cycle time for units per hour

label: Burn-in
subgoals: Convert the use and stress temperatures to kelvin
Multiply the difference of reciprocal temperatures by the activation energy over k
